annotations.title: Point a domain at a deployment

description: Point a domain the user owns on namemy.app at their deployment in one call: writes the platform's root and www records, replacing existing A/AAAA/CNAME records on those two hosts (other records are kept). Free. Returns the records applied and removed, plus `nextSteps` the user must do on the platform (e.g. add the domain in the Vercel project settings, or copy a verification TXT record). On failure, `restored: true` means nothing changed; `restored: false` comes with `live`, the records in place now (null if unknown), which is what to report. [Requires a free namemy.app API key — get one at https://namemy.app/app/api-keys]

dryRun.description: Validate and return the records that would be written, without changing anything

includeWww.description: Also point www at the deployment

value.description: The platform's hostname for the deployment: my-site.netlify.app, my-app.pages.dev, octocat.github.io, my-app.onrender.com, the *.up.railway.app target Railway shows after you add the domain there, or the my-app.fly.dev hostname / public IP from `fly certs setup`. Optional for vercel (only if its dashboard shows a *.vercel-dns*.com CNAME for www).
